data.name: Tonu
data.gender_notes: Tonu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bringer of joy and delight, derived from the Sanskrit root 'tam' which means 'to be' and 'nu' which means 'new'. The name Tonu carries the meaning “Delight, Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Tonu usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the joy and delight that comes from the present moment and the divine within.
data.etymology: Tonu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tonu total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
